This issuer displays strong profitability with a 65% gross margin, a 23% operating margin ($1,360M), and a solid annualized net income. However, the balance sheet presents highly elevated risk, characterized by a very low current ratio of 0.53 (current assets of $6,623M vs. current liabilities of $12,594M) and a heavily leveraged capital structure where liabilities ($84,798M) represent over 72% of total assets ($117,776M). This combination of robust earnings capacity offset by substantial short-term liquidity pressure and high leverage is consistent with a mid-to-lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
